analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see read. RSI at 45.4, exiting oversold and now ranging in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. Higher Low pattern potential forming with 5-day low above 20-day low. Volume at 0.54x 5-day average, indicating contraction. Considering volatility (ATR $16.29 or 2.37%), a break below swing support at $686.37 would trigger a stop loss at $665.19 (-1.3 * ATR). Target is swing resistance at $721.89, offering a 1.6x risk/reward ratio.
